plain_language_explanation: Positioned at root-level depth 1, this component directly exposes the Spring4Shell RCE vulnerability on web ingress endpoints. Active exploitation is confirmed in CISA KEV.
remediation_step: Upgrade Spring Boot to >= 2.6.6 or >= 2.5.12, ensuring Spring Framework is updated to >= 5.3.18 or >= 5.2.20.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 2 immediately beneath starter-web, Spring WebMVC handles HTTP request dispatching and data binding, making Spring4Shell directly reachable via crafted parameter binding.
remediation_step: Upgrade spring-webmvc dependency to >= 5.3.18 or update the parent Spring Boot BOM.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3 via spring-web, spring-beans executes JavaBean property binding, the exact mechanism exploited by Spring4Shell to obtain arbitrary class loader access.
remediation_step: Upgrade spring-beans to >= 5.3.18 or rely on updated Spring Boot 2.6.6+ dependency management.

plain_language_explanation: Operating at depth 3 inside embedded Tomcat, this KEV-listed vulnerability permits arbitrary file write and RCE via DefaultServlet path equivalence parsing.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.100 or migrate to supported Spring Boot 2.7+/3.x with updated embedded Tomcat.

plain_language_explanation: Embedded Tomcat at depth 3 exposes the Ghostcat vulnerability, allowing remote arbitrary file reading and code execution via misconfigured AJP connector handling.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.51 and disable the AJP connector if unused.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3 serving all incoming HTTP/2 traffic, Tomcat is susceptible to the Rapid Reset DDoS attack, threatening total availability of the root application.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.95 or configure an edge reverse proxy with rapid-reset mitigations.

plain_language_explanation: Direct first-party dependency at depth 1 that enables unauthenticated JNDI lookup RCE whenever the embedded H2 console or connection driver is exposed.
Direct depth 1 component allows remote code execution via JDBC URL INIT parameter script execution against the H2 console.
remediation_step: Upgrade com.h2database:h2 to >= 2.1.210 and disable h2-console in production profiles.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3 under spring-boot-starter, SnakeYAML's Constructor class enables polymorphic deserialization leading to unauthenticated RCE if untrusted YAML is accepted.
remediation_step: Upgrade org.yaml:snakeyaml to >= 2.0 or enforce SafeConstructor across all parser invocations.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3, embedded Tomcat on Windows hosts with CGI enabled allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via command-line argument injection.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.40 and ensure enableCmdLineArguments is set to false.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3 under the web starter, an invalid WebSocket payload frame length creates an infinite loop, starving the worker pool and causing complete service outage.
At depth 2, handling core HTTP responses, unsanitized Content-Disposition header construction allows reflected file download malware delivery.
At depth 3, directory redirection logic in DefaultServlet fails to sanitize URI paths, enabling external open redirection.
At depth 2 directly powering HTTP processing, HttpInvokerServiceExporter exposes Java deserialization of untrusted stream data leading to RCE.
remediation_step: Upgrade spring-web to >= 6.0.0 or discontinue use of HttpInvokerServiceExporter.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3, a TOCTOU race condition in JSP compilation on case-insensitive file systems enables remote arbitrary JSP file execution.
Premature URL decoding during rewrite processing at depth 3 permits bypass of request filtering and security constraint mappings.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to the latest patch release fixing regression bug 60013.

plain_language_explanation: Improper cleanup of invalid HTTP priority frames at depth 3 leaves dangling stream states that trigger resource exhaustion.
At depth 3, Tomcat SSI printenv directive fails to escape user environment values, allowing persistent cross-site scripting.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.40 and disable SSI servlets if unneeded.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3, FileStore session persistence allows deserialization of attacker-controlled session files when gadget libraries exist.
remediation_step: Upgrade tomcat-embed-core to >= 8.5.55 and ensure session persistence is configured securely.

plain_language_explanation: Depth 2 component serving static functional routing via WebMvc.fn enables directory traversal and arbitrary server file disclosure.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 2, wildcard mapping with XsltView allows remote attackers to trigger arbitrary stylesheet execution and SSRF/RCE.

plain_language_explanation: At depth 3, embedded Tomcat's default CORS filter configuration enables supportsCredentials with wildcard origins, leaking authenticated session data.
